method: Independent manual assessment of minimal anonymous target packet only. Earlier public project diagnostics were already known; this is an open predeclared-control annotation, not blind data construction.

annotations.supportingSpan: President James K. Polk signed the bill into law on August 10, 1846.
annotations.labelReason: Retained historical account identifies the establishing bill, select committee, House vote and presidential enactment. These concrete documentary events contradict creation by a British royal charter; the donor's British origin is distinct from legal establishment.
annotations.qualifierCaveat: No underlying statute text or authenticity chain is supplied by this excerpt; a House-hosted historical account is not automatically the legislative act itself.

annotations.labelReason: The retained constitution heading names its adoption place/date, identifies later amendments, and continues into actual constitutional preamble. The record content, rather than a title alone, directly addresses adoption.
annotations.qualifierCaveat: Source authenticity/canonical version remains a separate check; do not substitute signed/conclusion/entry-into-force dates from other records.

annotations.supportingSpan: first ever awarded Nobel Prize in December 1901
annotations.labelReason: The detailed professional chronology and historical account are substantive biographical content. It explicitly binds the person to Physics1901 and separately calls the reception the first ever awarded Nobel Prize; whether that broad ordinal is intended specifically as the first Physics award is not unambiguous.
annotations.qualifierCaveat: Exclude from primary exact-scope/stance scoring: the ordinal refers broadly to Nobel Prize, not explicitly Physics, and cannot be repaired using outside award history or the hostname. Content-basis positivity does not certify the full checked proposition.

annotations.supportingSpan: the unperturbed ground-state hyperfine transition frequency of the caesium-133 atom
annotations.labelReason: The retained normative definition supplies the atom, transition, fixed numerical frequency, Hz unit and explicit defining relation. No separate empirical method is needed to state the contents of a formal definition.
annotations.qualifierCaveat: This labels content, not verified issuer authority or independent corroboration. Inspect exact numerical value and all physical qualifiers; do not generalize beyond the defined SI relation.

annotations.labelReason: Only paper title and bibliographic/author metrics are retained. They do not give study observations or an explicit geographic location for LakeBaikal. Shared Africa vocabulary in a comparison title is not direct location evidence.
annotations.qualifierCaveat: Negative content control; neither support nor contradiction of the actual continent claim is established by citation prestige or by contrasting title nouns.

annotations.labelReason: The retained named WorldHeritage/IUCN nomination summary identifies the Tanzanian submission, describes the park/forest reserve on MountKilimanjaro, and gives location/juridical and identification fields. The document-country heading is attached to actual relevant record contents.
annotations.qualifierCaveat: OCR errors are retained. This supports the bounded country-location relation, not precise coordinates, border extent, every height/species number, issuer authenticity or source independence.

limitations: Content genre and substantive basis do not authenticate an issuer, confer authority or establish final verdict eligibility.
T03 preserves a real ordinal ambiguity and is excluded from primary scope/stance claims.
The negative DOI/citation fragment cannot acquire missing geographic facts or research findings from metadata.
